newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close at new high after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close at new high after U.S. data.

text.p: Swedish shares closed at a new all time high on Friday, opening with gains after a stronger close on Wall Street and boosted by better-than-expected unemployment data for January from the U.S..
The Stockholm general index rose 0.84 percent to a new record close of 2,578.71 with more gains expected. Shares worth 4.84 billion crowns changed hands.

"It was little bit cautious in the morning but after lunch you could see that it was looking like the U.S. bourse would rise... and we rose steadily. The strong dollar was also in focus," one broker said.
Gains were posted across the bourse with the only sector closing with losses the other industries section.
Bluechip stocks gained. Telecoms group Ericsson rose 2.5 to 244 crowns while drugs major Astra closed 3.5 higher at 348 crowns after hitting a new record high of 349.5 crowns.
Security company Securitas fell 3.5 to 217.5 crowns after posting a 17 percent rise in 1996 pre-tax profits.
Assa Abloy, the world's largest lock maker, rose one to 135 crowns after posting a 63 pct jump in 1996 profits.
